description: vanilla-epoll behind a stock edge for the gateway profiles: nginx terminates TLS + h2 (gateway-64) and Caddy terminates QUIC + h3 (gateway-h3); both serve /static/* from disk and forward /baseline2, /json and /async-db to the vanilla-epoll image over loopback HTTP/1.1 with a 2048-connection keepalive pool. The server is the vanilla-epoll entry unchanged (same Dockerfile), one worker per CPU of its cpuset, async pg_async pools, and /json served gzip from its lazy per-(count, m) cache when the edge forwards Accept-Encoding.
